The visibility problem for portfolios

Where a portfolio loses sight, and why.

01

Every site reports differently.

Different vendors and different measures make properties hard to compare, and the weakest one hides.

02

Problems surface late.

A property can slip behind its local competitors for weeks before occupancy or leads show it.

03

Attention is limited.

You cannot fix everything at once. You need to know which move counts most this week.

Questions

Answers, before you ask.

How do you compare properties in different markets?

Each property is measured against its own local market, then scored on the same Lift Score, so a portfolio view is a fair comparison.

Can ownership read the reports directly?

Yes. Every report is written to be read in minutes and forwarded as it is.

How many properties can you cover?

From a handful to a full portfolio. Each property gets the same weekly read and one recommended move.

Do property teams need to change how they work?

No. There is no new login. Teams receive one clear next step each week, and our team does the visibility work.
